name: Hirosoma Murasaki
source: [Url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou's[/url] and [Url=https://vndb.org/c105012]Shinku's[/url] loving mother, who was always kind, beautiful and gave everything to her children because she loved them dearly. [Spoiler]Later, it is revealed that [Url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou[/url] saw her through rose-coloured glasses. Murasaki was tired of her life and felt that her children weighed her down. Her hatred of [Url=https://vndb.org/c155087]Rokushou[/url] and the growing disdain for her children made her want to run away, abandoning them.[/spoiler]
